Annotated example differentially methylated regions

Source: R/exampleDMRs.R
exampleDMRs.Rd

DMR results for all pairwise contrasts between the type groups of exampleTumourNormal, annotated with hg38 gene information.

exampleDMRs

Format

A tibble with 109 rows and 57 columns, in the wide format returned by calculateDMRs(): one set of statistic columns per contrast (ten contrasts between NormalColon, CRC, NormalLung, LUAD and LUSC), the per-group _beta_means and _nrpm_means columns, and the gene annotation columns added by annotateWindows(). Use pivotDMRsLonger() to convert it to long format.

Source

Generated from exampleTumourNormal with calculateDMRs() (all contrasts of type) and annotateWindows(), using TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.knownGene and org.Hs.eg.db. See data-raw/exampleDMRs.R.

Examples

data("exampleDMRs", package = "mesa")
head(exampleDMRs)

#>   seqnames    start      end CpG_density CRC_vs_LUAD_log2FC CRC_vs_LUAD_adjPval
